parameters.content:
## 1. Read + Filter
Daily 09:00 run. Load config placeholders, read all invoices, keep only Pending, and skip any already reminded today.

## 2. Date Calc + Stage Routing
Compute days relative to due date, then route to the matching reminder stage. Unmatched days are ignored (no-op).

## 3. Stage Templates
Each stage sets its label, level, subject, tone instruction, and whether the manager is copied.

## 5. Email
Send via Gmail (manager CC at +14/+30). Log Sent / Failed / Skipped.

## 6. WhatsApp
Send via Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (HTTP). Log Sent / Failed / Skipped.

## 7. Update State
Advance reminder_level and stamp last_reminder so the same invoice is not reminded twice in one day.

## 4. AI Message
OpenAI writes the reminder (Continue On Fail). Merge Message re-attaches invoice fields; Build Message falls back to a fixed template if AI produced nothing.
